info.title: seq-mcp
info.description: MCP server for querying a Seq structured-log server with Seq SQL (group by / aggregates), recent errors, and event search.

commands.name: commands
commands.description: full command surface as JSON (for tools/agents)

options.name: --signal
options.description:
Saved signal id to scope to (from `signals`)
seq-mcp errors
Most recent Error/Fatal events (up to 20), newest first.

options.name: --minutes
options.description:
Look-back window in minutes (default: 30)
seq-mcp search   <filter>
Search events by a Seq filter expression, newest first.

options.name: --count
options.description:
Max events to return (default: 30)
seq-mcp event    <id>
Full detail for a single event by its id.
seq-mcp signals
List saved signals as Id · Title.

options.name: --filter
options.description:
Case-insensitive title substring
seq-mcp alerts
List configured alerts as Id · Title (with a [disabled] marker).
seq-mcp alert    <id>
Full detail for a single alert by its id.
seq-mcp alert-state
Alerts currently firing (Status · Occurrences · Last check).

options.name: --env
options.description:
target a configured Seq environment (default: the configured default)
seq-mcp commands       full command surface as JSON (for tools/agents)
seq-mcp --stdio        run as an MCP server over stdio
seq-mcp --http         run as an MCP server over HTTP
